notes:
Identity verified from title, authors, journal and DOI in supplied canonical text. Study 1 is Experiment 1. Locator p. 9 corresponds to source page 9 / journal p. 33: behavioral results give 30% of experimental trials, 71% of participants attempting to move the bag at least once, and 46% in at least half the trials; Table 1 gives baseline 0 for both participant summaries. That page prints no test statistic or p value for these behavioral outcomes. The generic description does not identify which outcome/test is assigned. Source p. 10 / journal p. 34 reports four distinct eye-fixation tests; none may be selected solely from the requested test-statistic metric. Printed candidates (canonical encoding retained): number of bag fixations: tð37Þ ¼ 6:82, P , 0:0001); total time fixating bag: tð37Þ ¼ 5:94, P , 0:0001); initial fixation on intended object: tð37Þ ¼ 4:7, P , 0:0001); final fixation on intended object: tð37Þ ¼ 7:9,
P , 0:0001). Each candidate is a t statistic with printed p < 0:0001 (bound l); these are separate tests, not alternative metrics for one test. This is an Experiment 1 participation count of 38, not an explicitly identified critical-model analytic sample.
